Supports: Acicular aragonite habit gives most frostwork spiny appearance; needles often radiate from popcorn nodules; frostwork can be other minerals, so generic habit does not alone establish mineral chemistry. WindCave image shows narrow straight needles and finer radiating branches, not curved gypsum petals.

sources.notes: Aesthetic reference only, never scientific authority. Concept D aesthetic clusters retained but its thick blunt-ended square rods rejected: actual straight needles become slender closed5-sided tapering prisms with sharp endpoints, branching secondaries narrower still. Five nodular source locations irregularly positioned on a compact limestone host. Around16primary needles per bundle plus finer sprigs along some stems, not broad crystals or flowers. Opaque rough ivory/cool cream PBR for portability, no transparency/refraction fidelity claim. All needles volumetric with positive radii and capped ends; component intersections at growth origins intentional, no floating stems. Host receives2quiet warmgray materials, needles2ivory materials.
